summary: WatchNexus v2.5.x Comprehensive Code Audit - All core functionality verified for Kickstarter launch readiness. 29/29 backend tests pass. All frontend pages (Music, Audiobooks, Library, Settings, Indexers, Downloads) working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: MusicPage.js and AudiobooksPage.js are well-implemented with proper data-testid attributes for testing
Both pages correctly filter libraries by media_type (music/audiobooks)
Audio playback implementation is clean with proper cleanup in useEffect
Empty states are properly handled with clear user guidance
seed_data_creation: Test created multiple music and audiobook libraries via API during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core functionality verified. Backend endpoints: Auth (register, login, me), Marmalade (libraries CRUD, scan, media, stream), Settings (get/update, sidebar tabs), Database (stats, reset), Compote (indexers, search), Downloads (engine/status), Zest (stats, health), TMDB (trending, search). Frontend pages all functional: Home (with featured content, continue watching, trending), Library (7 libraries visible with management controls), Music (libraries, track list, search, playback bar), Audiobooks (libraries, book grid, search, playback controls with speed adjustment), Settings (comprehensive config with sidebar tabs), Indexers/Compote (search with demo results), Downloads (queue management with built-in engine)
